# Justin Shaifer

> Justin "Mr. Fascinate" Shaifer is an award-winning STEM thought leader, enterprise AI trainer, and keynote speaker. He is a Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree in education, a LinkedIn Top Voice in Technology, and a LinkedIn Learning instructor whose AI courses have trained more than 150,000 professionals. He delivers customized AI keynotes and hands-on workshops for corporate teams and educators, virtually and in person worldwide.

## About
- Award-winning STEM thought leader, enterprise AI trainer, and keynote speaker on a mission to empower the world with innovation
- Forbes 30 Under 30 in Education; LinkedIn Top Voice in Technology
- LinkedIn Learning instructor; AI courses have trained more than 150,000 professionals
- Executive producer and on-camera talent at Fascinate Media, creating educational content about innovation, AI & STEM literacy, and the Future of Work
- Past clients and collaborators include LinkedIn, Intuit, NVIDIA, Google, PBS, Discovery, Bill Nye the Science Guy, and Al Roker
- TEDx speaker on Generation Z; hundreds of keynotes delivered worldwide
- Featured in Forbes, NBC News, Yahoo Finance, and AfroTech
- Available for virtual and in-person events worldwide

## Impact
- 150,000+ professionals trained
- 5M+ people reached
- 250+ corporate and educator clients
- 98% of audience members would see Justin speak again (audience data from Talkadot)

## Keynotes and workshops
Every session is customized to the client, industry, and audience.
- [Your Workday Streamlined with AI](https://justinshaifer.com/one-pagers/workday-ai.html): Practical AI tools and techniques to help corporate professionals transform daily workflows and boost productivity. Seen at Google, LinkedIn, Allstate, Madison Chamber of Commerce, DevLearn 2024.
- [AI Empowerment & Future of Work](https://justinshaifer.com/one-pagers/ai-empowerment.html): Preparing educators, leaders, and teams to thrive in an AI-driven world. Customized for higher education and K-12. Seen at NCTIES, Smithsonian, Antelope Valley College, Arizona School Boards Association, Concept Schools.
- [How to Engage Gen Z in STEM](https://justinshaifer.com/one-pagers/engage-gen-z.html): Bridge traditional teaching with modern demands to inspire the next generation. Delivered to more than 50,000 students worldwide. Seen at Purdue University, Miami Dade County Schools, USA Science & Engineering Festival, Dubai GITEX Future Stars.
- [Hands-on AI Working Sessions](https://justinshaifer.com/one-pagers/hands-on-ai.html): Interactive workshops where participants build real AI skills, including AI agents, AI browsers, and automated workflows, with examples tailored to their industry.

## Booking
- A standard keynote includes a pre-event discovery call, a customized 45-60 minute presentation, Q&A, and post-event resources for attendees
- Add-ons include breakout sessions, workshops, meet-and-greets, and extended working sessions
